SELECT id, user_id, workation_id, payment_source_type, merchant_name, amount, transaction_type, category_assigned, is_business_expense, approved_number, status, approved_at FROM transactions
ORDER BY approved_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_payment_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' THEN 1 END) AS total_payment_count FROM transactions

SELECT t.*, m.address AS merchant_address, m.category AS merchant_category, rv.review_id, rv.status AS review_status FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN reviews rv ON rv.transaction_id = t.id WHERE t.id = #{transactionId} AND t.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT t.*, m.address AS merchant_address, m.taxpayer_identification_number AS merchant_taxpayer_number, m.phone_number AS merchant_phone_number, cc.name AS card_company_name, c.card_name AS card_name, c.card_number AS card_number, c.card_classification AS card_classification FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id LEFT JOIN card_companies cc ON c.card_company_code = cc.code WHERE t.id = #{transactionId} AND t.user_id = #{userId}
